### BRINKER INTERNATIONAL TO HOST INVESTOR DAY ON SEPTEMBER 17


August 31, 2026


DALLAS


, August 31, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- Brinker International, Inc. (NYSE: EAT) will host an investor day on Thursday, September 17, 2026, at its headquarters in Dallas, TX. During the investor day presentation, Brinker's senior leadership team will discuss the company's long-term strategy, initiatives, and outlook. The presentation will begin at 8:30 a.m. CT and end at approximately 11:15 a.m. CT.


Due to limited capacity, in-person attendance is by invitation only. For those not attending the event in-person, a[live public webcast](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4764013-1&h=4052787803&u=https%3A%2F%2Flive.brinker.com%2F&a=live+public+webcast) can be accessed through Brinker's[investor relations website](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4764013-1&h=3858550542&u=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.brinker.com%2Fevents-and-presentations%2Fdefault.aspx&a=investor+relations+website) . A replay of the event will be available on Brinker's investor relations website until at least October 17, 2026.


**ABOUT BRINKER** **Brinker International, Inc.** (NYSE: EAT) is one of the world's leading casual dining restaurant companies and proud home to two beloved brands:[Chili's® Grill & Bar](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4764013-1&h=2494426098&u=https%3A%2F%2Fc212.net%2Fc%2Flink%2F%3Ft%3D0%26l%3Den%26o%3D4425688-1%26h%3D3915248301%26u%3Dhttps%253A%252F%252Fwww.chilis.com%252F%26a%3DChili%2527s%25C2%25AE%2BGrill%2B%2526%2BBar&a=Chili%27s%C2%AE+Grill+%26+Bar) and[Maggiano's Little Italy®](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4764013-1&h=3125480314&u=https%3A%2F%2Fc212.net%2Fc%2Flink%2F%3Ft%3D0%26l%3Den%26o%3D4425688-1%26h%3D2819574127%26u%3Dhttps%253A%252F%252Fmaggianos.com%252F%26a%3DMaggiano%2527s%2BLittle%2BItaly%25C2%25AE&a=Maggiano%27s+Little+Italy%C2%AE) . Brinker has grown to own, operate or franchise more than 1,600 restaurants across 29 countries and two U.S. territories – serving bold flavors, handcrafted drinks, and genuine hospitality along the way. Brinker is proud to have been named the top workplace in Dallas-Fort Worth by both the *Dallas Business Journal* and *The Dallas Morning News* in 2025, and CEO Kevin Hochman was awarded the 2025 IFMA Gold Plate Award and named a Barron's 2025 Top 25 CEO in the world. Brinker brands continue to earn national recognition as well with Chili's being honored in 2025 with placements on the *Fast Company* Brands that Matter and *Inc.* Best in Business lists and named *Ad Age* Brand of the Year among other honors. The purpose is simple: to make everyone feel special – whether it's a celebration over sizzling fajitas or a casual night enjoying Italian favorites with family. Learn more about our brands, our culture, and our people at[brinker.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4764013-1&h=1748446946&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.brinker.com%2F&a=brinker.com) and on[LinkedIn](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4764013-1&h=724053429&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.linkedin.com%2Fcompany%2Fbrinker-international&a=LinkedIn) .
